records.title: INSTALLATION OF FGD BY THERMAL POWER PLANTS
details:
In the statement referred to in
reply to parts (a) & (b): It
was inter-alia stated that out
of these, FGD has been
installed in 44 units (22,590
MW), contracts awarded/under
implementation in 233 units
(1,02,040 MW), 138 units
(43,987MW) are under
various stages of tendering
process and 122 units
(35,543 MW) are
under pre-tendering process

records.title: Deaths due to pollution in the country
details:
Target has been revised to achieve reduction in PM10 level up to 40% or
achievement of national standards (60 μg/m3) by 2025-26.

records.title: Non-construction of Railway over-bridge at Makhu on NH 54
details:
Hon'ble Minister inter-alia stated as under:
General Arrangement Drawings (GAD) of the ROB have been submitted to Railways for approval.
The work at ROB may be taken up after encumbrance free land is provided by State
Government.

records.title: Usage of regional languages in banking sector
Non-construction of Muktsar-Malout Road- NH 354A in Punjab
details:
Hon,ble Minister stated that:-
Sir, whether it is National Highway or not, it has to be confirmed. We are only authorized, we can work only on the National Highway. You mentioned it is NH. We do not know what his condition is now. I will verify and if it is NH, I will work to rectify it.
(original in Hindi)
